description: This is a unit test class for the TimeReportAPI, specifically testing the Attendance Report API endpoints within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It contains tests for retrieving a single report and expects exceptions for delete and update operations, indicating those are either unimplemented or restricted functionalities.

classes.name: AttendanceReportAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class verifying the behavior of TimeReportAPI endpoints related to attendance reports in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Test retrieving a single attendance report via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testGetOne' method.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that delete operation is not implemented and throws the expected exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks for proper handling of validation rules for delete operation, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests that the update method is not implemented and throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks for proper handling of validation rules for update, expecting a not implemented exception.
